tasks.title: Freeze arena problem and rubric
tasks.goal: Define one shared problem statement, constraints and weighted judging rubric before candidate outputs exist.
acceptance: Judging criteria are fixed before candidate outputs are compared.
verification: Review rubric for correctness, simplicity, maintainability, risk, testability and task-specific priorities.

tasks.title: Produce independent candidate A
tasks.goal: Develop one complete candidate approach in isolation.
acceptance: Candidate includes design, tradeoffs, risks and verification plan.
Candidate did not consume another candidate's output.

tasks.title: Produce independent candidate B
tasks.goal: Develop a second complete candidate approach in isolation.
acceptance: Candidate includes design, tradeoffs, risks and verification plan.
Candidate did not consume another candidate's output.

tasks.title: Produce independent candidate C
tasks.goal: Develop a third complete candidate approach in isolation.
acceptance: Candidate includes design, tradeoffs, risks and verification plan.
Candidate did not consume another candidate's output.

tasks.title: Judge candidates against frozen rubric
tasks.goal: Compare independent candidates by evidence and rubric rather than majority vote or author confidence.
acceptance: Each candidate is scored against the same rubric.
Chosen direction and rejected tradeoffs are explicit.
verification: Publish a comparison artifact before integration.

tasks.title: Integrate one coherent direction
tasks.goal: Implement or synthesize the winning direction without blindly merging incompatible designs.
acceptance: Integrated result has one coherent architecture.
Unchosen candidate assumptions do not leak into the implementation.
verification: Inspect final architecture against the winning rubric.

tasks.title: Verify arena result
tasks.goal: Run deterministic and real-product verification of the integrated result.
acceptance: Integrated result satisfies original acceptance criteria and rubric.

tasks.title: Attack arena winner
tasks.goal: Try to falsify the winning design after integration.
acceptance: Blocking counterexamples are resolved or explicitly escalated.
verification: Record counterexamples attempted and final disposition.
